ph1028a.title: JVC Victor Everio GZ-MG330-S 30GB HDD Camcorder 32x Zoom Silver with Dock
ph1028a.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
ph1028a.details: JVC Victor Everio GZ-MG330-S hard disk camcorder in silver, with a 30GB built-in hard disk drive, a Konica Minolta lens with 32x optical zoom and a flip-out LCD screen. It has a microSD card slot. Condition: operation was checked and it works, and playback of recorded video was confirmed on the LCD. A short video showing the playback is included in the listing. There are scuffs and wear from use, and the surface of the hand strap is worn and peeling, as shown in the photos. Included, as shown in the photos: the camcorder with its battery, a dock (cradle), an AC adapter with its cable. The USB cable, a manual and a memory card are not included. Please check the photos for the exact condition.
ph1028a.why: A used JVC Victor Everio GZ-MG330-S 30GB hard disk camcorder with a dock and AC adapter.
ph1028a.perfect: Video hobbyists and families who want a working Japanese hard disk camcorder.
ph1028a.exp: A pre-owned JVC Everio GZ-MG330-S camcorder with the strap wear described above, with a dock and AC adapter.
ph1028a.cd: Pre-owned with scuffs and wear from use. The hand strap is worn and its surface is peeling. Operation was checked and it works, and playback of recorded video was confirmed. A short video of the playback is included. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
